description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewDetail' class, which extends 'SugarView'. It manages the display of detailed views in the SuiteCRM application by utilizing the 'DetailView2' class to setup and process detail view rendering.

classes.name: ViewDetail
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the detailed view display of a record within SuiteCRM, managing setup and rendering of the detailed view using DetailView2.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the DetailView2 object and sets it up with the module, bean, and metadata before the view is rendered.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the detailed view of the record, verifying the presence of a record ID before rendering.
